2026-11-25: harness defect in docs/agent/kernel-api.md. It never showed that the orders table is two-dimensional (orders[row, column]) and did not say its 64-row limit is per call, so the agent wrote orders[row * 6 + column] and rationed orders per day. The engine refused the resulting rows and stopped the run. The campaign was stopped after this trial, the document fixed, and the question re-run as btc-mm-orderflow-02. Excluded from N as a platform failure.

2026-11-25: harness limit in scripts/run_native_trial.py. Its scoring step built one Python object per fill, so it refused runs over 5,000,000 fills. This ordinary market-making kernel made 56,681,717 fills over the train split. Scoring now runs from fill columns for large runs (column_score, shown equal to the blotter path), and the question re-runs as btc-mm-orderflow-03. Excluded from N as a platform failure.

2026-11-26: harness defect. A24 D4 measures market-making returns after inventory marks, and the scorer did not mark inventory: it booked P&L only when a position closed. Trial 4 (index 3) went short 600 lots at about 17,270 on 2023-01-10 and held it to the end of the train split, near 108,200, so funding was counted daily and the open loss, about 5,460 USDT, never was; it scored +1.07 and scores -0.10 with marks. The campaign was stopped by hand during trial 5. Scoring now marks inventory at each session's close and the market-making gate is off until Amendment 26. Excluded from N as a platform failure.
